name: AI选聘 (Looplood)
tagline: Organize user-selected resume materials in your own Feishu Bitable
description: AI选聘 (Looplood) helps recruiting teams organize candidate materials they actively choose into their own Feishu Bitable. Users can collect currently viewed candidate profiles, selected webmail attachments and local resumes in PDF, DOCX, PNG or JPG format. The workflow keeps resume facts, source information and original materials together for human review and team collaboration. It is designed to reduce manual copying between selected recruiting materials and a structured table. Hiring decisions remain with people; the product does not promise autonomous candidate sourcing or hiring decisions. Annual plans cost CNY 199 for email workflows, CNY 299 for recruiting-platform workflows and CNY 399 for the full plan. The trial includes three basic synchronizations and excludes AI analysis; there is no permanently free plan. The interface and public documentation are primarily in Chinese.
